_doc: Runtime config for the X bot. One post/day, pillar rotates by UTC weekday (see `rotation`; run.ts maps today's weekday to a slot, or takes --slot explicitly). Budget guard tracks spend against the prepaid X credit balance.

budget._note: balanceCents is cumulative lifetime funding, not a resettable pool: remaining = balanceCents - state.creditsSpentCents (which never resets). History: 500 (launch) -> 586 on 2026-08-06 (confirmed $0.86 left at X, creditsSpentCents pinned at 500 since exhausted 2026-07-20) -> 1086 same day after a further $5.00 top-up at X ($5.86 now available). To top up again: balanceCents += (new cents funded at X). X bills a post containing a URL at $0.20/request vs $0.015 plain (per X's write-ops pricing), so the caption only includes the deep link back to the site when |BTC day-over-day move| >= linkThresholdPct; otherwise it stays link-free at the cheap rate. monthlyCap is a hard ceiling on posts/month regardless of balance (now generous at 1/day; kept as a safety net).

_rotationDoc: Index = UTC weekday (0=Sun..6=Sat, JS Date#getUTCDay). null = scheduled day off. Currently Mon-Sat one pillar each, Sunday quiet.
_dailyUtcHourDoc: 0 UTC = ~8pm ET, picked for US retail/crypto-native evening scroll time (also catches early Asian trading-day open). Not yet verified against this account's own engagement data — X's Owned Reads pricing (GET /2/users/{id}/tweets, $0.001/resource) now makes it cheap to pull real post history and confirm/adjust this once there's enough post volume to compare.
